new_value: Fixture reconciliation completed. Root cause: lichen-rpl message.rs is_generalized_target_body (the envelope guard for OPT_RPL_TARGET) checked only prefix-len/length consistency, not the Target flags octet (body[0]). So a DAO carrying a Target option with nonzero flags (spec 8.6 R-05-035: nonzero rejects the DAO) passed the envelope parse; verify_signature succeeded structurally, and the test's structural-stage assertion failed because the rejection was expected at this stage but didn't fire. Fix: added body[0] == 0 to is_generalized_target_body, matching the C extract_updates/dodag.c check and the Python dao_origin.py data[0] != 0 reject. This makes verify_signature return Err(DaoVerifyError::Malformed) for nonzero Target flags at the structural stage, which the test already pinned. Verification: nonzero_target_flags test green; lichen-node 296 lib tests green; lichen-rpl 238 lib tests green. Codereview delegated to kimi-k3 (consolidated) in prior rounds; the envelope guard approach was confirmed correct (matches C extract_updates + Python dao_origin.py) and the test oracle independence was confirmed.
